summaries: Marcus finds his long-lost military friend Toby Wren shivering and amnesiac on the freezing moors. Sensing severe danger, he carries him down the mountain to seek urgent medical attention.

Dr. Nair confirms Toby is suffering from a dangerous high fever and unresponsive pupils, while two tense Aldersgate representatives arrive demanding his release. Marcus flatly refuses to let them take him, but Toby's condition begins to rapidly deteriorate.

MARCUS.visible: wet mountain rescue gear, missing red outer jacket
MARCUS.knows: Toby Wren is alive, has a severe fever, cannot remember him, has an Aldersgate wristband, and Aldersgate representatives are actively trying to claim him.

PRIYA.knows: she signed the Aldersgate safety summary two years ago (secret); Toby's temperature is 39.2C with fixed pupils; Aldersgate Clinical Research wants him back immediately.

TOBY.visible: hospital gown, army greatcoat, bare feet, Aldersgate wristband, silver dog tags
TOBY.knows: nothing, memory erased; instinctively hums a four-note melody.

GAZ.knows: two men in grey suits from Aldersgate are at the hospital doors demanding Toby's release.

LINNEA.carries: orange sample case, hidden satellite phone

PEGGY.visible: wearing a fresh white plaster cast on her left wrist
